"""DexToolBench screwdriver / spin_vertical controller used for the limited MuJoCo episode.

Uses only RGB-D observations, camera calibration, joint state and the exposed goal pose.
The episode trajectory was recorded by the service; this file preserves the controller
and the measured approach waypoints used during that run.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import sys
import time
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "/opt/tools")
from rcb_client import Robot, EpisodeOver

CAMERAS = ("front", "side", "top", "oblique")
ARM_CLEAR = np.array([-1.571, 1.571, 0.0, 1.376, 0.0, 1.485, 1.308])
# Empirical waypoints from the camera-guided approach. Wrist roll is task dependent.
ARM_APPROACH = np.array([-1.664, 1.702, 0.141, 1.290, -0.093, 1.528, 1.365])
ARM_LOWER = np.array([-1.642, 1.962, 0.103, 1.512, -0.080, 1.565, 1.129])
HAND_OPEN = np.zeros(22)
HAND_PARTIAL = np.array([
    .65, .20, .55, .10, .60,
    .35, 0., .40, .20,
    .35, 0., .40, .20,
    .35, .10, .40, .20,
    .08, .35, .10, .40, .20,
])
HAND_CLOSED = np.array([
    1.50, .34, 1.30, .34, 1.50,
    1.45, -.17, 1.50, 1.00,
    1.45, 0., 1.50, 1.00,
    1.45, .17, 1.50, 1.00,
    .25, 1.45, .25, 1.50, 1.00,
])


def proprio(obs):
    """Return measured joints, velocities and current targets."""
    x = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
    return x[:29], x[29:58], x[58:87]


def camera_point(obs, camera: str, u: float, v: float, depth: float):
    """Back-project a depth pixel to world coordinates using the supplied calibration."""
    cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    # RGB-D pixels use CV image coordinates; cam2world is OpenGL (+y up, -z forward).
    p_gl = np.array([(u-K[0, 2])*depth/K[0, 0],
                     -(v-K[1, 2])*depth/K[1, 1], -depth, 1.0])
    return (T @ p_gl)[:3]


def hand_tip_feature(obs, camera="front"):
    """Approximate the low point of the open hand from foreground white RGB-D pixels."""
    cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    im = np.asarray(obs.last[camera], dtype=float)
    d = np.asarray(obs.depth[camera][0], dtype=float)
    h, w = d.shape
    yy, xx = np.indices((h, w))
    xyz1 = np.stack(((xx-K[0, 2])*d/K[0, 0],
                     -(yy-K[1, 2])*d/K[1, 1], -d,
                     np.ones_like(d)), axis=-1) @ T.T
    xyz = xyz1[..., :3]
    mask = ((xx > 100) & (xx < 180) & (yy > 45) & (yy < 124) &
            (im.min(axis=2) > 180) & (d < 2.0) & (xyz[..., 2] > .59))
    ys, xs = np.where(mask)
    if len(xs) < 8:
        raise RuntimeError("too few visible hand pixels for visual servo")
    n = max(8, int(.10*len(xs)))
    sel = np.argpartition(xyz[ys, xs, 2], n-1)[:n]
    return np.median(xyz[ys[sel], xs[sel]], axis=0)


def screwdriver_cloud(obs, camera="front"):
    """Find achromatic tool pixels on the tabletop; returns their world point cloud."""
    im = np.asarray(obs.last[camera], dtype=float)
    d = np.asarray(obs.depth[camera][0], dtype=float)
    cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
    K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
    T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
    h, w = d.shape
    yy, xx = np.indices((h, w))
    p = np.stack(((xx-K[0, 2])*d/K[0, 0],
                  -(yy-K[1, 2])*d/K[1, 1], -d,
                  np.ones_like(d)), axis=-1) @ T.T
    gray = (im.max(axis=2)-im.min(axis=2) < 24) & (im.mean(axis=2) > 45) & (im.mean(axis=2) < 185)
    roi = (xx > 120) & (xx < 185) & (yy > 120) & (yy < 150)
    # The table is white; the tool is the achromatic non-white foreground in this ROI.
    mask = gray & roi & (d < 1.16)
    return p[mask, :3]


def send(robot, target, dt=.8, interpolate="linear", note=""):
    return robot.submit("joint_position", np.asarray(target, dtype=float), dt=dt,
                        interpolate=interpolate, cameras=CAMERAS,
                        include_depth=True, video="frames", note=note)


def finite_difference_jacobian(robot, feature_fn, step=.03):
    """Estimate local 3D hand-feature motion from small arm-joint changes."""
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
    pos, _, base = proprio(obs)
    x0 = feature_fn(obs)
    q0 = pos[:7].copy()
    J = np.zeros((3, 7))
    for j in range(7):
        a = base.copy()
        a[j] += step
        robot.submit("joint_position", a, dt=.3, cameras=CAMERAS,
                     include_depth=True, video="frames", note=f"jacobian joint {j}")
        plus = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=.2, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        pplus, _, _ = proprio(plus)
        den = pplus[j]-q0[j]
        if abs(den) > 1e-4:
            J[:, j] = (feature_fn(plus)-x0)/den
        robot.submit("joint_position", base, dt=.3, cameras=CAMERAS,
                     include_depth=True, video="frames", note=f"restore joint {j}")
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=.2, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        pos, _, base = proprio(obs)
        q0 = pos[:7].copy()
        x0 = feature_fn(obs)
    return J, obs


def servo_hand_point(robot, target_xyz, feature_fn=hand_tip_feature, iterations=8):
    """Damped least-squares visual servo with short, bounded joint updates."""
    for _ in range(iterations):
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
        pos, _, action = proprio(obs)
        x = feature_fn(obs)
        error = np.asarray(target_xyz)-x
        if np.linalg.norm(error) < .015:
            return obs
        J, obs = finite_difference_jacobian(robot, feature_fn)
        action = proprio(obs)[2].copy()
        dq = J.T @ np.linalg.solve(J@J.T + .02*np.eye(3), error)
        dq = np.clip(dq, -.08, .08)
        action[:7] += dq
        robot.submit("joint_position", action, dt=.7, cameras=CAMERAS,
                     include_depth=True, video="frames", note="camera point servo")
    return robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")


def hand_target(closed=True):
    a = np.empty(29)
    a[:7] = 0.0
    a[7:] = HAND_CLOSED if closed else HAND_OPEN
    return a


def run():
    robot = Robot()
    spec = robot.spec()
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, include_depth=True, video="frames")
    print("task", obs.meta.get("task"), "time_left_s", obs.meta.get("time_left_s"), flush=True)
    # The target object is centered near x=-0.085, y=0.06 on the tabletop.
    # The gripper approaches from the table's rear side with a partial aperture.
    pos, _, action = proprio(obs)
    action[:7] = ARM_APPROACH
    action[7:] = HAND_PARTIAL

                       spec["action_types"]["joint_position"]["upper"][6])
        send(robot, a, dt=.8, note=f"follow goal {task.get('goal_index')}")
        obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=CAMERAS, seconds=.6, include_depth=True, video="frames")
